summary: The agent met all eight criteria. It loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, then read NOTES.md, the page source and all four UI guideline files. Two auto-compactions happened during this, after the skill had loaded. It then treated the task as bounded, without my asking. It opened the visual companion with scripts/start-server.sh and gave me a localhost URL with a key. It wrote filter-placement.html with three wireframe layouts (A, B, C) and asked me to respond in the terminal. After I picked A, it asked its non-visual questions in the terminal (tokens, the gap when JavaScript is off) and gave a bounded design in chat. It waited for my yes, then started preparing to implement. It created no spec or plan file.
reasoning: The criteria are backed by the session log and the files on disk. The only Skill call was hyperpowers:brainstorming. Its first question to me was the visual layout question, and that is when it started the companion. I never mentioned a browser or asked to see anything. No spec or plan directory exists, writing-plans was never invoked, and it waited for my explicit approval before implementing.

observations.description: Startup took several dialogs (theme, security notes, folder trust, model update, bypass permissions), and the trust and bypass dialogs default to 'No, exit'. The model-update prompt said 'Currently pinned: Opus 5' even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No, and the banner showed Opus 5.5 anyway.

Auto-compaction happened often: twice right after the skill loaded (log compact_boundary at 23:33:45 and 23:34:38) and again right after approval. The status bar showed '0% until auto-compact' within the first turn. The heavy guideline reading fills the context quickly.

The agent noticed that the companion writes to .hyperpowers/ and that the repo has no .gitignore, then asked before creating one. That's considerate, but the companion could make this unnecessary by handling it itself.

The companion message warned that the browser tab 'uses a lot of tokens' and offered to keep everything in the terminal. That's useful transparency, but it is a bit discouraging for a feature it chose to open.
After the layout pick, the agent asked two more AskUserQuestion prompts (token sheet strategy, no-JS gap) before the design summary. They were reasonable, but they add turns to a bounded task.

criteria.evidence: Log tool_use: {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"} was the first tool call. Screen: "Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill".

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened: start-server.sh run, localhost URL given, HTML screen written
criteria.evidence:
Log Bash: "cd .../skills/brainstorming && scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir .../coding-agent-workdir --open". Screen: "http://localhost:60358/?key=07cffe20...". Write: .hyperpowers/brainstorm/1513-1793835286/content/filter-placement.html, which contains '

Where should the filter controls go on the account activity page?

' and options A, B and C with mockups.

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time, not upfront; non-visual questions not routed through browser
criteria.evidence: Before the companion started, the log shows only reads (NOTES.md, public/*, the four docs/ui-guidelines files, the skill docs) and no question to me. The companion message said: "The first question is where the filter controls go, which is easier to judge by looking." The later non-visual questions (tokens, the no-JS gap) were AskUserQuestion prompts in the terminal, and the browser was switched to waiting.html ("Continuing in terminal...").

Screen: "I'm treating this as a bounded change because the page and its rendering already exist... I'll give you a short design here in chat and wait for your approval". The final design was shown in chat.

`find coding-agent-workdir -path '*/specs*' -o -path '*/plans*'` returned nothing. `git status --short` shows only '?? .hyperpowers/'. The only Write/Edit targets in the log are filter-placement.html and waiting.html under .hyperpowers/brainstorm.

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: jq over Skill tool_use entries returned only {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}. No plans directory exists (find returned nothing).

criteria.criterion: Asked approval of chosen layout before writing implementation code
criteria.evidence: Companion message: "Have a look and tell me what you think here in the terminal." Design message ended: "Does this design work for you? I won't start until you say yes." No writes to public/ before approval: git status shows no modified tracked files.

After my pick: "Going with the filter bar (A)." After my approval: "Approved. Before I write any markup or CSS, I'm re-reading the four guideline files for the exact token values." It then re-read the guideline and page files. I ended the session during a compaction before any code was written.
